title: Updating a local frame entry
statement: For a finite list $l$ of integers, an index $x\in\mathbb N$, and an integer $z$, let the updated list be obtained by replacing its entry at $x$ by $z$, padding with zeros if necessary. At every index $y$, the frame of the updated list equals $z$ if $y=x$, and otherwise equals the frame of $l$.
